LanguageData.HD_TacticalTakedown_CommandDesc: Select an unaware target within four tiles from behind, then approach to strike. Walls do not block selection, but a reachable route is required. Immobilization or a blocked route cancels the approach. Instant kill destroys the selected vital part and kills the target on contact.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalTakedown_InvalidTarget: The target does not meet the takedown conditions.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalTakedown_ReasonUser: Requires a drafted, standing CQB-trained pawn.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalTakedown_ReasonRange: The target must be within {0} tiles.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalTakedown_ReasonDetected: The target has detected or previously attacked this pawn.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalTakedown_ReasonAnomaly: Anomaly creatures cannot be taken down.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalTakedown_ReasonPart: No eligible lethal part with maximum health of {0} or less. Clothing with sharp armor of 20% or less is ignored; stronger armor still blocks takedowns.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalTakedown_NoPath: No reachable path to the target.
